'''Calcium carbonate''' was a natural chemical compound. In caves, [[rock]] formations known as stalagmites and stalactites formed through deposition of the calcium carbonate contained in [[Water/Legends|water]] drippings.<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>
